descript.abstract: This dataset contains linear features that represent the locations of Private, State, and USACE Bank Protection Projects along the Sacramento River from Colusa to Red Bluff.
descript.purpose: This dataset was created to both document and graphically represent Bank Protection Projects along the Sacramento River.

citeinfo.origin: California Department of Water Resources, Northern Region Office
citeinfo.title: Historical_Bank_Protection_v5_20180522

idinfo.useconst: This is a DRAFT dataset. This dataset does not provide a legal delineation of Bank Protection Projects. Rather, the dataset provides a graphical representation and source for documenting known projects along the Sacramento River.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: This dataset was created to both document and graphically represent Bank Protection Projects along the Sacramento River.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This dataset contains linear features that represent the locations of Private, State, and USACE Bank Protection Projects along the Sacramento River from Colusa to Red Bluff.
dataIdInfo.idCredit: Adam Henderson, CA Department of Water Resources. Adam.Henderson@water.ca.gov

Consts.useLimit: This is a DRAFT dataset. This dataset does not provide a legal delineation of Bank Protection Projects. Rather, the dataset provides a graphical representation and source for documenting known projects along the Sacramento River.

metainfo.metstdn: FGDC Content Standards for Digital Geospatial Metadata

attrdomv.udom: Sequential unique whole numbers that are automatically generated.

attr.attrdef: The source of the construction date information. This attribute corresponds to an aerial atlas in most cases, but maybe a aerial photo, map, O and M Manual, or actual field survey. Sources are used in combination to determine when the revetement documented on the river.
The agency responsible for construction of the bank protection.

This field corresponds to the reaches designated in the Sacramento River Conservation Area Forum. Reach 1 is from Keswick to Red Bluff, Reach 2 is from Red Bluff to Chico Landing, Reach 3 is from Chico Landing to Colusa. Reach 4 is from Colusa to Verona.
The Bank Protection Project or program associated with the feature; if known.
The State Reclamation Board number associated with the bank protection project. From O and M Manual and reports.
The California Department of Water Resources number associated with the bank protection. From O and M Manual and reports.

The year by which the bank protection was removed or washed away. This is not necessarily the year the bank protection was removed or washed away, but the year it was documented no longer there. Determined by aerial photos, maps, or surveys. Bank protection maybe placed in a similar location at a later date.
Comments associated with the OUTBYDATE field.
LMA Unit identified in the O and M Manual
LMA Unit identified in the O and M Manual
Notes on the process of documentation and/or existing conditions by the data steward.
These are notes copied from the O and M Manual
Site Number provided by the O and M Manual.
Based on the USACE 1991 Sacramento River Atlas
These are lengths described in the O and M manual. These will differ from the GIS measured length
